change: Extend dotted selection updates to NDArray slices. Capture explicit bounds for every axis, including omitted trailing axes, before the RHS. Reuse scoped source snapshots and reacquire destination storage with its current strides. Add the missing four-dimensional generic zeros overload.
validation: Independent C bootstrap: 917 numeric, compound, slice/index and formatter checks passed in 32.19s. Ruff and git diff --check passed.
coverage: row, column and rectangular updates with scalar and vector broadcasting
RHS changes matrix dimensions; open and omitted axes remain bound to original coordinates
parent array growth and receiver/bound/axis expressions evaluated once in order
rank three and rank four, per-axis end, float32 zeros and arithmetic
managed strings, saved value copies and repeated-work allocation cleanup
constant destinations rejected; incompatible shapes, wrong result counts, invalid source bounds and undersized resized destinations fail
limits: Forward unit ranges only; stepped and stored matrix range selectors remain unsupported.
Selected data, result and axis metadata are materialized; this change adds ergonomics, not an allocation-free update path.
No performance claim for matrix slice updates.
